content.bridge_context: Moving from basic addition/subtraction to handling positive and negative numbers together.

units.title: The Number Line with Negative Numbers
units.explanation: Negative numbers are to the left of zero. They represent values less than nothing (like debt or cold temperature).
units.dual_language_instruction: Mark -3 and +3 on a number line. / संख्या रेखा पर -3 और +3 अंकित करें।

units.title: Signs for Multiplication
units.explanation: Like signs give positive (+ * + = +, - * - = +). Unlike signs give negative (+ * - = -).
